## My first document

```{r}
# load libraries
library(palmerpenguins)
library(tidyverse)

PenguinData <- penguins
```

The dataset has `r nrow(PenguinData)` rows and `r ncol(PenguinData)` columns. The number of distinct species is `r n_distinct(PenguinData$species)` that come from `r n_distinct(PenguinData$island)` different islands. The mean body mass is `r round(mean(PenguinData$body_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE), 2)` g, with a minimum body size of `r round(max(PenguinData$body_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE), 2)` g.
